input_messages.content: Hi! I need some help with my recent orders and account details. I just moved to a new house on Elm Avenue here in Houston, and I noticed that one of my orders was sent to my old address. I’d like to update the shipping address for that order to my new place, and also set my new home as my default address for future orders. Can you help me with that?
Sure, my email is sophia.martin4832@example.com. Let me know if you need anything else to verify my account.

Actually, I’d prefer not to share my address directly. Since both my old and new homes are on Elm Avenue, and my recent orders should have the details, could you please look up the addresses from my order history? I’d like you to update the shipping address for the order that’s still set to my old place, and also make sure my new home is set as my default address. Let me know if you need any other info from me! 

Also, once we get the address sorted, I’d like to exchange the tablet I just bought for the cheapest one you have, since moving has been expensive.

Yes, that’s exactly right! Please update the shipping address for order #W1092119 to 760 Elm Avenue, and set 760 Elm Avenue as my default address for future orders.

Once that’s done, I’d like to go ahead with exchanging my tablet for the most affordable one you have. Let me know what the next steps are for the exchange.

Yes, using my Mastercard ending in 3292 is fine for any price difference or refund. Please go ahead and let me know which tablet is the cheapest option and what I need to do next for the exchange. Thanks!

Yes, I confirm that I want to exchange my current 7-inch, 32GB, gold tablet for the 7-inch, 128GB, black tablet at $941.03, and I’m fine with the refund going to my Mastercard ending in 3292. Please go ahead and process the exchange and send me the return instructions. Thank you!

Thanks for letting me know! In that case, I’d like to modify my pending order #W1603792 to the more affordable tablet option you mentioned—the 7-inch, 128GB, black tablet at $941.03. Please update my order to reflect this change and confirm when it’s done.
Yes, please proceed with modifying my order as described. That’s the only change I want to make. Thank you!

That’s perfect, thank you for your help! I don’t need anything else right now. Have a great day! 

###STOP###
